full_judgment: Md. Abdur Rouf J: This petition for leave at the instance of the pre-emptor, is against the judgment and order passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division on 14 June 1995 in Civil Revision Case No. 6256 of 1991 (Dhaka) making the Rule absolute and setting aside thereby the judgment and Order dated 21 June 1987 passed by the Assistant Judge, Khulna rejecting Miscellaneous Case No. 83 of 1986, filed under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the order dated 11 December 1986 passed ex parte in Miscellaneous Case No. 37 (preemption) allowing pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
